base: Full-body character concept for a 3D game, front view, A-pose, arms slightly away from the body, open empty hands, plain light-grey background, soft even lighting, no shadow, single person, realistic proportions, detailed fabric and skin texture, photorealistic. Setting: Kingdom of Dahomey (West Africa), 1890s. No weapon in hands, no text, no watermark.
